🇬🇧 The Immigration and Asylum Bill will charge asylum seekers up to £10,000 towards accommodation — in instalments, once they're earning, before settlement.

Set against £4 billion a year in support costs, it recovers pennies, years late, from the subset who end up in work. It accepts the arrivals, the hotels, the bills — then posts an invoice. The way to save £4 billion is to stop running the broken system.
